pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown, irregularly shaped polygonal regions. Edges exhibit a smooth pixel gradient rather than sharp angularity. Patches on the lower flank and upper limbs show a significant reduction in relative spatial area compared to the larger, more elongated patches on the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light pelage pathways with a relatively narrow, uniform pixel width. Topology consists of well-defined junction nodes connecting three to four pathways, maintaining high continuity across the torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal neck line, appearing as a soft, dark fringe against the light background.
